description: Recorded responses of two public music APIs and one short audio excerpt, for the source adapters' tests and the Media search smoke. Recorded 2026-11-02.

ia_search_bach.json.request: https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php?q=(bach) AND mediatype:audio AND licenseurl:* AND NOT collection:(librivoxaudio OR audio_bookspoetry OR podcasts OR radioprograms OR oldtimeradio)&fl[]=identifier,title,creator,licenseurl&rows=12&output=json

ia_metadata_open_goldberg.json.edits: kept metadata.identifier, title, creator, licenseurl, mediatype and each file's name, source, format, length, title, original; everything else dropped

audius_search_bach.json.edits: kept id, title, duration, permalink, is_streamable, is_stream_gated, is_available, license, genre, user.name, user.handle, artwork.150x150; everything else dropped

ia_metadata_toccata.json.edits: kept metadata.identifier, title, creator, licenseurl, mediatype and each file's name, source, format, length, title, original; everything else dropped

toccata_bwv565_excerpt.mp3.work: J. S. Bach, Toccata and Fugue in D minor BWV 565 (from the fugue)
toccata_bwv565_excerpt.mp3.performer: Ashtar Moira, Tamburini organ, the performer's own recording released to the public domain (via Wikimedia Commons, as the item's page states)
toccata_bwv565_excerpt.mp3.edits: seconds 260 to 290, mono, 22.05 kHz, 64 kbit/s MP3 (ffmpeg -ss 260 -t 30 -ac 1 -ar 22050 -b:a 64k)
toccata_bwv565_excerpt.mp3.beat: trackSongGrid reads 163.7 bpm, confidence 0.72 (decoded by ffmpeg; a browser's decoder may differ slightly)
